rules.label: Rules
rules.description: Posts the server rules and grants an access role on acceptance.

feedback.disabled: ❌ This module is disabled on this server.
feedback.roleGone: ❌ The access role no longer exists. Please tell an administrator.
feedback.cannotAssign: ⚠️ I cannot assign the access role (missing “Manage Roles” permission or the role is above mine).
feedback.error: ❌ Something went wrong. Please try again later.
feedback.alreadyUpToDate: ✅ You have already accepted the current version of the rules.
feedback.accepted: ✅ Thanks, you accepted the rules! Your access is unlocked.
feedback.revalidated: 🔄 Thanks for accepting the new version of the rules!

g0.label: 📜 Rules
g0.description: After any change, republish the rules with the “Publish” button.

channelId.label: Rules channel
channelId.help: The channel the rules are posted in. Make it readable by everyone and writable by no one: it is often the only channel an unverified newcomer can see.

roleId.label: Access role (granted on acceptance)
roleId.help: The role given to a member who accepts. It is what should open the rest of the server: with no role here, the button records the acceptance but unlocks nothing.

title.label: Title
title.help: The title of the rules message.

content.label: Rules content
content.help: The rules text, up to 4,000 characters. Editing it does NOT ask those who already accepted to accept again — that is what the version number is for, when a rule changes enough to require re-acceptance.

buttonLabel.label: Accept button label
buttonLabel.help: The accept button's text. Word it in the first person (« I accept »): it is what the member declares by clicking.

logChannelId.label: Acceptance log channel
logChannelId.help: A channel recording each acceptance, with who and when. It is the only record that answers « had they accepted the rules? » the day the question comes up. Empty, nothing is kept.
